Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1332
Claimant:
Lisa Moore
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
20 Mar 2023
Claim reported by the insured after a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The insured states the
other vehicle drifted into their lane as they moved over, and the driver is named on the policy.
13 Apr 2023
Recorded statements from two independent witnesses and the other driver all describe the collision the same way as
the insured. Police confirm the claimant was seated in the insured vehicle at the time.
30 Apr 2023
Photos of the vehicle show damage along the right side that matches the described impact. A few older scratches are
visible in the same area, and they may predate this loss, so they will be separated during estimating.
12 Jul 2023
Coverage history reviewed. Nothing indicates the damgae occurred before the policy period began, and the vehicle
was insured continuously through the loss date.
15 Jul 2023
Claimant reports knee pain from the collision and is represented by counsel. Claimant has given the same account of
events in every conversation so far. No prior injury to the knee is known from the records obtained, though it is not yet
clear whether the injury resulted from this crash.
27 Aug 2023
Medical records received show treatment that followed a tyipcal course, with visits tapering off as the claimant's
condition improved. Causation remains under review pending the treating provider's written opinion.
1 Oct 2023
File remains open for the medical causation review and receipt of the final bills. Liability appears clear based on the
consistent statements and physical evidence, and the damage estimate is being finalized.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
